name: Hand gestures — signal → meaning → action
role: Cam recognizes Aaron's hand signals on the companion camera, remembers what each one means, and fires the bound action: collapse / expand / scroll the page, move Cam from one device to another (iPhone → iPad), control the converse turn

huawei_air_transfer.what: HarmonyOS 5 / Mate 70 · Mate X6 · MatePad Pro — open palm at half an arm, pause, clench fist to grab the open image / video / playing track / screenshot; keep the fist, move to the receiving phone or tablet, pause, open palm to send
huawei_air_transfer.requirements: both devices HarmonyOS 5, Bluetooth + WLAN on, screens unlocked, Air Transfer switch on, ≥ 40 cm between devices
huawei_air_transfer.developer_surface: Share Kit harmonyShare.gesturesShare event — page registers a listener, gets a SharableTarget, must call share() within ~3 s; system owns discovery, connection, transfer

huawei_air_gestures.what: Air scroll (palm / back of hand 20–40 cm, wrist flick up/down/left/right), Grabshot (palm then clench fist), Air press (palm from 30–40 cm to ~5 cm answers a call or pauses / resumes playback); hand icon appears at the top of the screen when engaged

mediapipe_gesture_recognizer.what: On-device (WASM in Safari) hand landmarker + canned classifier: None, Closed_Fist, Open_Palm, Pointing_Up, Thumb_Down, Thumb_Up, Victory, ILoveYou; custom .task via Model Maker (folders per label + none)

recognizer.engine: scripts/cam_gesture_engine.py — HaGRID labels + hand-gesture-mediapipe keypoint / point-history k-NN (trained live from the submodule CSVs) + HandGestureRecognition key frames + Cam finger rules; pose fusion → per-hand segmenter → motion head → Segment → GestureResolver

eyes.companion_pwa: companions/web/gestures.js — MediaPipe tasks-vision GestureRecognizer (Safari WASM, CDN) on the camera preview; landmarks + canned label batched to POST /api/spike/hand every 200 ms; overlay, engaged glyph, intent line, reversible UI actions; ?gesture-demo=NAME dry run without a camera
eyes.pupil: world-camera frames through the same runner when Pupil is live
eyes.hagrid_detector: optional — HaGRID YOLO / ResNet labels enter as labels.hagrid on each hand

recognizer.custom_model: data/gestures/cam-gestures.task — Model Maker on HaGRIDv2 folders (integrations/hagrid) + Aaron's samples — optional now; rules / HaGRID labels / Aaron prototypes already cover every custom pose
recognizer.desktop_path: integrations/hagrid pretrained detectors or integrations/hand-gesture-mediapipe app.py on the Mac when its slot opens
recognizer.landmarks_leave_device: 21 points per hand, no pixels, tailnet only
recognizer.emits: segments pose:motion:duration_ms:confidence:hands → GestureResolver (server) → intents back to the companion + vault/10-Mesh-Distillates/converse/*-gestures.jsonl

aaron_repos.note: Each repo Aaron adds mounts as a submodule and is mapped onto primitives.poses / primitives.motions in gestures.json (repos.*) — the vocabulary stays the source of truth. gesture-check fails if a repo label is neither mapped nor explicitly ignored.

repos.use: HaGRIDv2 dataset (33 static classes + no_gesture, 1.09M images) → Model Maker folders for every custom pose; pretrained YOLOv10 / ResNet gesture + hand detectors for the Mac / desktop path
repos.maps: repos.hagrid.pose_map (25 labels → 13 poses), 9 labels ignored / reserved

repos.use: segmenter reference — keypoint MLP (Open / Close / Pointer) and 16-frame fingertip point-history MLP (Stop / Clockwise / Counter Clockwise / Move); teach-mode pipeline (k / h to log samples → notebook → TFLite)

repos.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 — patterns and datasets only, no code shipped
repos.use: dynamic-gesture research (key-frame extraction + feature fusion, Neurocomputing 2019); Cambridge / Action3D / HandGesture classes seed motion primitives and counting poses

aaron_repos.next_slot: integrations/<gesture-repo> — open for the next repo Aaron adds

defaults.switch_default: hold — every recognized gesture is system.log_only until Aaron flips switch.gesture_control after the first live session
